Saint-Venant Torsion of Rectangular Section

Input data

Dimensions of cross section

a = 50  cm , b = 30  · cm2 = 15 cm

Torsional moment - Mt = 20  kNm

Number of iterations - n = 10 

Analysis

k ( i )  = 2 · i + 1 , α ( i )  = k  ( i )  · πa

Factors for calculation

C = Mt4 · a4 · (b12 · a − 8π5 · n∑i= 01k  ( i ) 5 · tanh ( α  ( i )  · b ) ) = 20 kNm4 ·  ( 50 cm ) 4 · (15 cm12 · 50 cm − 83.1415935 · 0.7408531) = 14.203188 MPa ∕ m

C1 = 4 · C · aπ2 = 4 · 14.203188 MPa ∕ m · 50 cm3.1415932 = 2.878168 MPa

Shear stress calculation

τzx ( x; y )  = C1 · n∑i= 01k  ( i ) 2 · cosh ( α  ( i )  · b )  · sinh ( α  ( i )  · y )  · sin ( α  ( i )  · x ) 

τzy ( x; y )  = C · (a2 − x) − C1 · n∑i= 01k  ( i ) 2 · cosh ( α  ( i )  · b )  · cosh ( α  ( i )  · y )  · cos ( α  ( i )  · x ) 

Results

Peak values

τzx (a2; b) = τzx (50 cm2; 15 cm) = 1.882666 MPa

τzy  ( 0 cm; 0 cm )  = 1.563499 MPa
